before.algorithm: sort expanded score and label arrays for every resample

after.algorithm: pre-sort tie groups and compute multiplicity-weighted ranks

method: Two separate local process runs of scripts/benchmark_forward_read_path.py --rows 1200 --samples 20; the cold probe explicitly clears the bounded bootstrap cache before each of five requests.
limitations: This is not a controlled paired CPU benchmark; scheduler and thermal variance were not estimated.
No hosted network, Postgres query plan, edge cache, serverless cold start, concurrency, or production SLO is measured.
Synthetic scores and labels are not model or investment performance evidence.
